About the Project

The MRC Exposome Immunology programme supports doctoral work on how environmental exposures interact with the immune system. Studentships are hosted at Manchester and Oxford, with separate deadlines and application routes at the two universities.

Research Areas

  • Immunology
  • Environmental exposures
  • Biomedical research

ComponentDetails

About University of Manchester

Manchester hosts doctoral programmes in medicine, bioscience and other research fields. Its Faculty of Biology, Medicine and Health coordinates funded training routes, including MRC programmes and cancer research studentships.
